files.title: File:Clay County bridge 14-060-032 historical marker 1.JPG
files.author: Ammodramus
files.caption: Historical marker describing concrete arch bridge carrying 458 Avenue across Spring Creek, northeast of Wakonda in rural Clay County, South Dakota.  In 2016, when the photo was taken, the arch bridge depicted on the marker was apparently no longer extant; a concrete box culvert carried the creek under the road.
